exercises.hint: Create Vendor with name VARCHAR(20), then insert all four vendors in one INSERT.
Predict first. Then type the statements in ./sql shell iceadmin and look.

assert.sql: SELECT name, website, country, brandManager FROM Vendor ORDER BY name
assert.equals: Adobe, https://adobe.com, USA, 1 | Digital Marketing Institute, https://digitalmarketinginstitute.com, Ireland, 2 | Linux Professional Institute, https://lpi.org, USA, 3 | Microsoft, https://microsoft.com, USA, 3

exercises.hint: CREATE TABLE, then ALTER TABLE Vendor CHANGE COLUMN name name VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, then the INSERT.
